description: Break a goal, funnel or custom event's conversions down by each visitor's first visit: referrer, UTM source/medium/campaign and landing page. touchWebsiteIds adds visits on other websites in the organization.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

limit.description: Values to list per breakdown, 1-25; defaults to 10.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

subject.description: The conversion to attribute: a saved goal, a saved funnel or a custom event.

field.description: Visitor dimension or properties.<key> on the conversion event.

operator.description: How to compare the selected field with value.

value.description: Comparison text, or a list for membership matching; numeric comparisons use number text.

filters.description: Extra filters on top of the goal's own, as get_goal_analytics takes them, so the conversions match its count.

funnelId.description: Funnel ID from list_funnels; a conversion completes it.

eventName.description: Custom event name; its first occurrence is the conversion.

field.description: Visitor dimension or properties.<key> on the conversion event.

operator.description: How to compare the selected field with value.

value.description: Comparison text, or a list for membership matching; numeric comparisons use number text.

filters.description: Narrow which events count: a listed field or properties.<key>. Profile traits are not supported here.

to.description: Inclusive end of the measurement period; pair with from instead of preset.

touchWebsiteIds.description: Other websites in the organization whose pageviews count as first visits, such as the marketing site for an app signup. A funnel's own websites always count.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

windowDays.description: Days before each conversion to look for the visitor's first visit, 1-90. Defaults to 30.

name: get_conversion_attribution

outputSchema.description: conversions counts converting visitors; with_first_visit those with a pageview in the window. Each dimension lists values by conversions, with share of with_first_visit and other_conversions for the rest. An empty value is a direct visit or no UTM tag. identity says how visits were matched to people.

title: Get conversion attribution
